title: Toys ‘R’ Us Is Prepping to Liquidate Its U.S. Operations
主要内容: Toys ‘R’ Us Inc. is preparing to liquidate its U.S. operations following its bankruptcy filing last year. The company has failed to secure a buyer or reach a debt restructuring deal with lenders. A shutdown of the U.S. division is increasingly likely, though the situation remains fluid. Hopes for a buyer or lender agreement are fading.
